Beekie.text: Beekie has bet one shape every time, and it has not worked: four 5-point, three-leg long-shot parlays, all lost, for -20. Every leg is a player's points or a game total, with six of eight props on guards and overs and unders split evenly. Only 3 of 12 legs have hit, with props 2-6 and totals 1-3. The weekly boost went on a +608 parlay that missed. All four went in during one sitting about six hours before tip, and none copied Claude. The reads are not bad, but needing three at once is the leak. Read: a game-script parlay builder who should try two legs.

Kev.text: Kev is the cleanest bettor in the book: four singles, all won, for +51.77, with no parlays at all. He lives near even money, three of four bets between -130 and +130, and he picks road sides, backing away teams three times and underdogs twice, both cashing. Portland has been his team twice. He bought a safer alt number once and spent his boost on a +108 moneyline that hit. Stakes run 10 to 30 points, he bets about seven hours before tip, and he has never copied Claude. Nothing is broken yet. Read: a disciplined road-dog side bettor.

Mio.text: Mio is the safety buyer, and it is paying: 4-0 for +82.27 on the biggest stakes in the group, 20 to 50 points. Three of the four are two-leg parlays and all six legs hit, because six of seven legs used alt lines bought down to a safer number. Every price has been favorite or near even. Props are all overs, including two points-rebounds-assists combos, mixed with spreads, a total and a moneyline. The boost went on a parlay at -190 that cashed. One bet went in within an hour of tip; none copied Claude. Read: a grinder who buys safety.

Sulliver.text: Sulliver has the most bets in the group, seven, and the roughest start at 1-6 for -68.91. Every prop is an over on a star, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander twice, then Giannis, Kyrie, Wembanyama, Flagg and Hartenstein, and props are 2-5. Singles are 1-4 and both three-leg parlays missed.
